title: Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) - update
summary: Disease Outbreak News: On 25 December 2013, WHO has been informed of five additional laboratory-confirmed case of Middle East Respiratory Syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) in Saudi Arabia.

title: Human infection with avian influenza A(H7N9) virus – update
summary: On 15 and 16 December 2013, the National Health and Family Planning Commission, China notified WHO of two new laboratory-confirmed cases of human infection with avian influenza A(H7N9) virus.

title: Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) - update
summary: WHO has been informed of an additional two laboratory-confirmed cases of infection with Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) in Saudi Arabia.

title: Chikungunya in the French part of the Caribbean isle of Saint Martin
summary: On 6 December 2013, WHO was notified of two laboratory confirmed cases of locally acquired chikungunya disease in the French part of the Caribbean isle of Saint Martin.

title: Yellow fever in Sudan - update
